input: Natal chart (birth chart) kya hota hai?

input: Apna sun sign kaise pata karein?

input: Moon sign aur sun sign me kya farq hai?
output: Sun sign aapki core identity batata hai; Moon sign emotions aur instinctive responses dikhata hai.

input: Ascendant (rising sign) kya hota hai?
output: Ascendant woh zodiac sign hota hai jo birth time par eastern horizon par tha; yeh first impressions aur life approach shape karta hai.

input: Kya horoscopes accurate hote hain?
output: Horoscopes general guidance dete hain. Exact insights ke liye exact birth time aur place ke saath full natal chart chahiye hota hai.

input: Apna moon sign kaise calculate karein?
output: Moon sign calculate karne ke liye birth date, time aur place ka use karo, saath me ephemeris ya chart calculator (Swiss Ephemeris recommended) use karo.

input: Astrology me synastry kya hota hai?
output: Synastry do natal charts compare karke relationship dynamics aur compatibility analyze karta hai.

input: Transit kya hota hai?
output: Transit current planetary positions ko aapke natal chart ke relative dikhata hai, jo events ya mood shifts ka timing batata hai.

input: Solar return chart kya hota hai?
output: Solar return chart tab banaya jata hai jab Sun apni natal position par har saal return karta hai aur yeh aane wale saal ke themes dikhata hai.

input: Lunar node (Rahu/Ketu) kya hai?
output: Lunar nodes karmic direction dikhate hain—Rahu growth/obsession areas batata hai, Ketu past-life tendencies aur detachment dikhata hai.

input: Jupiter 7th house me hone ka matlab kya hai?
output: Jupiter 7th house me aksar partnerships me luck, beneficial relationships, aur dusron ke through opportunities lata hai.

input: Saturn 10th house me hone ka matlab kya hai?
output: Saturn 10th house me discipline aur long-term career responsibilities dikhata hai; steady effort se success milta hai.

input: Retrograde planets ko personally kaise affect karta hai?
output: Retrograde planet ke themes ka review, revision ya internalization laata hai (jaise Mercury retrograde = communication review).

input: Astrology me 12 houses kya represent karte hain?
output: 12 houses life areas dikhate hain: self, values, communication, home, creativity, work, partnerships, transformation, travel, career, friendships, spirituality.

input: Nakshatra kya hota hai?
output: Nakshatra Vedic astrology me lunar mansion hai—27 sectors hote hain jinke specific qualities personality aur timing affect karte hain.

input: Dasha (Vimshottari) kya hota hai?
output: Dasha ek planetary timing system hai jo dikhata hai kaunsa planet kis period me life ko influence karega.

input: Planetary aspects kaise interpret karein?
output: Aspects (conjunction, square, trine, etc.) planets ke interaction dikhate hain—harmonious aspects energy flow smooth karte hain; tense aspects challenges create karte hain.

input: Kya astrology marriage predict kar sakta hai?
output: Astrology marriage ka timing aur compatibility factors indicate kar sakta hai, par exact events decide nahi karta—free will important hai.

input: Panchang kya hota hai?
output: Panchang Hindu calendar hai jo tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana aur sunrise/sunset timings deta hai—muhurta aur rituals ke liye use hota hai.

input: Achha muhurta kaise choose karein?

input: Astrology me solar eclipse kya karta hai?
output: Solar eclipse aksar major beginnings ya shifts laata hai—important events ya changes eclipse-affected houses ke themes me hote hain.

input: Astrology me lunar eclipse kya karta hai?
output: Lunar eclipse culminations, emotional endings, ya revelations la sakta hai—aksar closure affected areas me hota hai.

input: Chart ruler kaise read karein?
output: Chart ruler woh planet hai jo ascendant sign ko rule karta hai—uska condition aur house placement major life themes aur energy direction dikhata hai.

input: Stellium kya hota hai?
output: Stellium 3+ planets ek sign ya house me hone ko kehte hain, jo us life area me energy aur emphasis concentrate karta hai.

input: Planetary dignity kya hota hai?
output: Dignity batata hai ki ek planet ek sign me kitna comfortable hai (domicile, exaltation = strong; detriment, fall = challenged).

input: Kaunse planets communication govern karte hain?
output: Mercury communication govern karta hai, par Mercury ke aspects aur house expression ko modify karte hain; Gemini aur Virgo Mercury traits emphasize karte hain.

input: Kaunsa planet love aur relationships govern karta hai?
output: Venus traditionally love, relationships, beauty aur values govern karta hai (Vedic me Venus = Shukra).

input: Karmic astrology kya hoti hai?
output: Karmic astrology past-life patterns aur lessons study karti hai jo nodes, Saturn, aur chart patterns se life purpose aur debts indicate hote hain.

input: Eclipse timing kaise work karta hai?
output: Eclipses agar aapke natal planets ya angles ke paas hote hain to significant events trigger karte hain; timing house placement aur aspects par depend karta hai.

input: Progressed chart kya hota hai?
output: Progressed chart natal planets ko symbolically move karta hai (jaise, one day = one year) taaki inner development aur personal growth ka timing dikh sake.

input: Life path number kaise find karein?
output: Life path number (numerology) birth date ke digits ko add karke single digit me reduce karke calculate hota hai (master numbers 11, 22 ko alag treat kiya jata hai).

input: Numerology me number 1 ka matlab kya hai?
output: Number 1 leadership, independence, ambition aur initiative signify karta hai.

input: Numerology me number 7 ka matlab kya hai?
output: Number 7 introspection, spirituality, analysis, aur deep thinking se related hai.

input: Remedial gem (ratna) practice kya hai?
output: Gem remedies me gemstones ka use hota hai jo planets se linked hote hain, taaki beneficial planets strong ho—sirf expert chart analysis ke baad use karein.

input: Fasting (upvas) remedy kaise kaam karta hai?
output: Specific days par fasting jo planets se linked hote hain (jaise, Saturday for Saturn) traditional remedy hai negative planetary effects kam karne ke liye.

input: Transit chart reading kya hota hai?
output: Transit reading current planetary positions ko natal chart se compare karke active themes aur events ka timing identify karta hai.

input: Astrology career choices me kaise help karta hai?
output: Astrology natural strengths (houses, ruler placements) highlight karta hai aur career changes ka timing (Jupiter/Saturn transits, progressions) dikhata hai.

input: Composite chart kya hota hai?
output: Composite chart do charts ko merge karke ek single chart banata hai jo relationship ko ek entity ke roop me describe karta hai (midpoint method).

input: Vedic vs Western astrology kitni accurate hai?
output: Dono systems insights dete hain; Vedic lunar/house-based predictions aur dasha systems par focus karta hai, Western solar signs aur aspects par—jo resonate kare use karo.

input: Vedic astrology me yog (yoga) kya hota hai?
output: Yoga ek planetary combination hai jo specific results deta hai; kuch yogas wealth, obstacles ya special talents indicate karte hain.

input: Rahu-Ketu placements kaise interpret karein?
output: Rahu worldly ambition aur obsessions dikhata hai; Ketu detachment aur spiritual tendencies—house placement life focus batata hai.

input: Compatibility report kaise generate hota hai?
output: Compatibility moon signs, ascendants, planetary placements ka use karke banta hai, aur Vedic me gun milan (kundali matching) criteria follow hota hai.

input: Gun Milan kya hota hai?
